title: To Find Growth in Today's Market, CEOs Need a New Compass
figure_ref: Exhibit 2 — How Three TSR Outperformers Combine Mutually Reinforcing Growth Vectors (editorial TSR paired dots)
business_context: BCG argues companies should combine reinforcing growth vectors rather than follow one universal growth playbook. Exhibit 2 illustrates three companies' growth-vector combinations alongside five-year shareholder returns. The published panel makes the sector comparison explicit for Trane and Brinker but not numerically for Aurobindo.
key_message: Trane Technologies (23% vs 5% median) and Brinker International (32% vs 0% median) outperformed their respective sector medians in five-year annualized TSR; Aurobindo Pharma delivered 13% but its numerical sector comparator was not disclosed.
so_what: Compare growth-path choices against comparable industry baselines, without treating observed TSR outperformance as causal proof.
original_chart_type: Three circular growth-vector compass panels with annualized TSR captions
encoding: x=annualized TSR, y=company in exhibit order, dots=company versus sector median, connector=percentage-point gap, direct labels; one missing benchmark plotted only as a single dot.

data_spec.observation_unit: company x five-year annualized TSR period
data_spec.source: BCG ValueScience / S&P Capital IQ; sample count not disclosed for this exhibit; company and sector returns include reinvested dividends.

data_recipe: Fix consistent five-year TSR period and peer selection.
Calculate annualized dividend-reinvested TSR for company and industry median.
Mark unavailable comparator as missing, never zero.
Use paired dots for known company–median pairs and one unpaired dot for unknown benchmark.
Check whether external factors could explain TSR outperformance.
message_conditions: Same return measure, period, and currency are used for comparison.
S&P 500 industry median is not an individually matched competitor.
Observed outperformance is descriptive, not a causal estimate.
design_moves: x=annualized TSR, y=company in exhibit order, dots=company versus sector median, connector=percentage-point gap, direct labels; one missing benchmark plotted only as a single dot.
Source and neutral themes configurable; data-driven coordinate calculation
diff_notes: Original six-vector radial graphics are not reproduced; the new quantitative dot chart is a deliberate editorial redesign. Aurobindo median not disclosed.
